meta.title: Projects — ACC & Associates
meta.description: Selected case studies: apartments, health precinct, industrial estate, boarding school, retail dilapidation, public infrastructure superintendent.

intro.headline: What we've been called in to fix.
intro.lede: Client names and unit numbers changed where confidentiality applies. Numbers and dates are not.

items.problem: Head contractor served a 71-day extension of time claim on a $54m apartment build, citing wet-weather and utility connection delays. The developer suspected concurrent delay had not been accounted for in the contractor's windows.
items.intervention: As-planned vs as-built analysis over four windows spanning October 2021 to April 2022. Reconstructed the critical path from daily site diaries and P6 update files, cross-referenced against BoM weather records for the Sydney basin.

items.problem: Mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic subcontracts were disputed five months before target Practical Completion. RFI backlog stood at 340+ items and the previous contract administrator had resigned.
items.intervention: Took over contract administration under AS 4902. Cleared the RFI register in six weeks, re-based the variation register, and negotiated separately with each of the three services subcontractors.

items.problem: Slab movement of up to 38 mm was discovered across three completed tenancies four months after handover. The tenants were withholding rent; the owner was mid-way through refinancing.
items.intervention: Full defect inspection, geotechnical review, and liaison with the original engineer. Prepared a rectification scope suitable for tender and for negotiation with the head contractor under the DLP.

items.problem: The client was considering commencement of a $47m stage-two build against a cost plan prepared eighteen months earlier by the design architect. The board wanted an independent read before authorising the tender.
items.intervention: First-principles cost plan against the current schematic set. Bill of quantities to elemental level, benchmarked against three comparable completed projects.

items.problem: Landlord was pursuing an outgoing tenant for $890k in make-good obligations under a schedule of condition prepared fifteen years earlier. Matter was filed in the NSW Supreme Court.
items.intervention: Expert report on the tenant's side. Reconstructed the baseline condition from the original schedule, current photography, and building code changes over the tenancy term. Attended expert conclave; gave two days of testimony.

items.sector: Public infrastructure — bridge widening, arterial road
items.problem: Mid-project resignation of the appointed superintendent on an AS 4000 contract with two subcontractor disputes already live. The principal had 22 weeks left on programme.
items.intervention: Took over as named superintendent. Ran monthly certifications, issued three formal determinations, and mediated both subcontractor disputes to written settlement.

primary.label: Handed over on the contract completion date

secondary.label: Sub-contractor disputes settled without SOP adjudication
